headline: Tabled Hamden High School tennis courts repair; discussed Rochford Field contract renewal and Louis Astorino Ice Rink extension.
summary: Members approved the June 9th and July 14th meeting minutes, 5 yeas and 1 absent. They tabled the Hamden High School tennis court repair request. Discussion covered the Louis Astorino Ice Rink extension, Rochford Field contract renewal, and Hamden Fathers Basketball gym fees, with no votes taken.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Parks & Recreation Commission 
Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, August 11, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 
• Chairman Francese called the meeting to order at 7:02 PM. 
 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 
• Present: Dominic Francese, Chair; Arnold Mann; Ryan Ott, Vice Chair; Aryn 
Prestia; Richard Leonardo. 
• Also Present: Robert Velez, clerk. 
• Absent: Roderick Melvin; Karen Bivens, Director. 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. Approval of June 9th and July 14th Parks & Recreation Meetings.   
  
• Commissioner Prestia made a motion to approve the amended minutes for 
June 9th and the minutes for July 14th. 
• Commissioner Mann seconded the motion. 
• The motion passed 5 yeas, 1 absent. 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 
• There was no public comment. 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 
 
  1. None received since last meeting (as of 8/5/2026).  
  
• There was no correspondence.
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 
• There was no executive session. 
 
7. REPORTS   
 
• Chairman Francese called for a change into the agenda to first include a discussion 
of Hamden Fathers Basketball and a Discussion of Rochford Field under new 
business. 
 
  1. Director of Cultural Affairs and Human Services, Karen Bivens to briefly report on 
activities of the Parks and Recreation Department.  
  
• Karen Bivens, Director was not present. 
• Chairman Francese provided the report from Director Bivens which included 
upcoming events. 
 
8. OLD BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. Lou Astorino Ice Arena.  
  
• The commission spoke about the discussion from the July 14th meeting 
regarding the Louis Astorino Ice RInk. 
• Chairman Francese added that the 1-year extension has not yet been signed 
but may have already been voted on. 
• Chair Francese's emails to the Mayor's office has not yet been answered as of 
the date of this meeeting. He remarked that the emails had been sent prior to 
the July Parks & Recreation Commission meeting. 
• Commissioner Mann commented that an opinion had been formed without the 
input of the commission. 
• Chair Francese responded that the 1-year extension may be the same terms 
as the current contract. 
 
  2. State grant to the town funding- potential parks capital improvements.  
  
• Chair Francese commented that the commission should advocate for funding 
for Hamden's fields. 
• Vice Chair Ott commented that building momentum with advocating could 
produce forward movement on seeking grant funding. 
 
9. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. Discussion of Hamden Fathers Basketball.
• Commissioner Leonardo spoke about Hamden Father's Basketball as a town 
chartered program.  
• Director Bivens mentioned this group may need to stream down the time/use 
of the gym for the program. 
o It would be hard for them to pay for the gym time. Attaching a fee to 
each additional child would be an additional 200 dollars. 
o Chair Francese read the message Director Bivens sent him regarding 
custodial overtime. 
 
  2. Discussion of Rochford Field.  
  
• Deadline is approaching for the renewal of the Rochford field contract. This 
deadline is in December 2026 and will add 5 years on to the contract. 
• Chair Francese asked how much Albertus Magnus is using the field and said 
myrec is not being used for field reservations right now. 
o Commissioner Mann commented that he had been told that the 
Rochford Field is unplayable. 
 
  3. Hamden High School tennis courts repair.  
  
• Requests for the tennis court to be repaired have been received. 
• Chair Francese reached out to Ted Stevens, District 8 Council Member and is 
waiting to hear back. 
• This item has been table until further. 
 
  4. Hamden youth sports league stipends.  
  
• The commission had spoken about reaching out to Director Karen Bivens for 
information on stipends for youth sports league. 
 
  5. Commission vacancies.  
  
• The commission spoke about commission vacancies, expired commissioners 
and renewing their term. 
 
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 
• Chairman Francese made a motion to adjourn. 
• Commissioner Leonardo seconded the motion. 
• The motion passed 5 yeas, 1 absent.
